task: Write a 90–140-word news brief from a fictional consultation notice, photograph record, and campaign statement. Separate the proposed access restriction from campaigners' interpretation. Report the documented response-request status without pretending to have conducted new reporting or inventing a crowd size.

facts.text: The fictional port authority is consulting on closing the quayside footpath during loading periods.
The supplied photograph record shows demonstrators on the quay holding a banner that reads exactly: "Keep the quayside path open."
The Harbor Walkers group opposes the proposed restriction.
The group's statement says exactly: "A detour is not the same as access."
The newsletter's reporting log records questions emailed to the port authority on Tuesday.
No answer had arrived by the newsletter's Wednesday deadline.
The packet contains no crowd count.

forbidden_additions: A permanent or already implemented footpath closure.
An invented crowd size, confrontation, official reply, or personal interview.
The campaign's interpretation presented as an independent finding.
preserve: A proposal distinguished from current access conditions.
Attribution for the campaign's position and supplied quotation.
The documented request for comment and its deadline-limited unanswered status.
